    BALLAST_DENSITY = 150.0  # Increased density for mass without excessive beam size

    def _hull_deck_top(sandbox):
        position = sandbox.get_boat_position()
        hull_y = float(position[1]) if position else 2.4  # New environment's hull center y
        return hull_y + 0.2, hull_y  # Deck top is 0.2 m above hull center

    deck_top, hull_y = _hull_deck_top(sandbox)

    # Ballast beams (lowest possible within build zone to lower center of mass)
    # Minimum y for beam center = BUILD_Y_MIN + (BALLAST_HEIGHT / 2) = 2.58 + 0.05 = 2.63
    ballast_positions = [
        (13.5, 2.63, BALLAST_WIDTH, BALLAST_HEIGHT, BALLAST_DENSITY),  # Left ballast
        (15.0, 2.63, BALLAST_WIDTH, BALLAST_HEIGHT, BALLAST_DENSITY),  # Center ballast
        (16.5, 2.63, BALLAST_WIDTH, BALLAST_HEIGHT, BALLAST_DENSITY),  # Right ballast
    ]

    # Side rails (height=1.0 m, centered at y=deck_top + 0.5 m)
    rail_positions = [
        (BOAT_LEFT_X, deck_top + 0.5, RAIL_WIDTH, RAIL_HEIGHT, 25.0),
        (BOAT_RIGHT_X, deck_top + 0.5, RAIL_WIDTH, RAIL_HEIGHT, 25.0),
    ]

    # Cross beams to connect side rails and distribute load
    cross_beam_positions = [
        (14.5, deck_top + 0.3, 0.8, CROSS_BEAM_HEIGHT, 20.0),  # Left-center cross beam
        (15.5, deck_top + 0.3, 0.8, CROSS_BEAM_HEIGHT, 20.0),  # Center-right cross beam
    ]

    # Diagonal supports between ballast and cross beams
    diagonal_supports = [
        (14.0, deck_top + 0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 15.0),  # Left diagonal support
        (16.0, deck_top + 0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 15.0),  # Right diagonal support
    ]

    # Cargo stops to prevent front-back and side motion
    stop_positions = [
        (14.5, deck_top + 0.1, 0.2, STOP_HEIGHT, 20.0),  # Left stop
        (15.5, deck_top + 0.1, 0.2, STOP_HEIGHT, 20.0),  # Right stop
        (15.0, deck_top + 0.1, 0.3, STOP_HEIGHT, 20.0),  # Center stop
    ]

    bodies = []

    # Add ballast beams
    for x, y, w, h, d in ballast_positions:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x, y, w, h, density=d)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.01)
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, None, (x, y), type="rigid")
        bodies.append(beam)

    # Add side rails
    for x, y, w, h, d in rail_positions:
        rail = sandbox.add_beam(x, y, w, h, density=d)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(rail, restitution=0.01)
        sandbox.add_joint(rail, None, (x, y), type="rigid")
        bodies.append(rail)

    # Add cross beams
    for x, y, w, h, d in cross_beam_positions:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x, y, w, h, density=d)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.01)
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, None, (x, y), type="rigid")
        bodies.append(beam)

    # Add diagonal supports
    for x, y, w, h, d in diagonal_supports:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x, y, w, h, density=d)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.01)
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, None, (x, y), type="rigid")
        bodies.append(beam)

    # Add cargo stops
    for x, y, w, h, d in stop_positions:
        stop = sandbox.add_beam(x, y, w, h, density=d)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(stop, restitution=0.01)
        sandbox.add_joint(stop, None, (x, y), type="rigid")
        bodies.append(stop)

    # Final mass check
    total_mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
    if total_mass > MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:
        raise ValueError(f"Structure mass {total_mass:.2f} kg exceeds limit {MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:.2f} kg")

    return bodies[0] if bodies else None
